name: embpw
title: Satellite embeddings 2017 (population-weighted)
description: Sixty-four satellite embedding dimensions (A00–A63) for Bolivia's 339 municipalities in 2017: the population-weighted mean, over each municipality, of the annual 10 m embeddings from the Google Satellite Embedding dataset (AlphaEarth Foundations), which summarise Sentinel-2, Landsat and other imagery. The dimensions are abstract features, designed as inputs to machine-learning models, e.g. to predict poverty.

sources.title: Brown, C. F., Kazmierski, M. R., Pasquarella, V. J., Rucklidge, W. J., Samsikova, M., Zhang, C., et al. (2025). AlphaEarth Foundations: An embedding field model for accurate and efficient global mapping from sparse label data. arXiv:2507.22291.
sources.geo:creator: Google and Google DeepMind
sources.geo:attribution: The AlphaEarth Foundations Satellite Embedding dataset is produced by Google and Google DeepMind.

sources.title: WorldPop & CIESIN (2018). Global High Resolution Population Denominators Project (100 m, 2000–2020). University of Southampton and Columbia University. Funded by the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation (OPP1134076).
sources.geo:creator: WorldPop (University of Southampton, University of Louisville, Université de Namur) and CIESIN, Columbia University

sources.title: Runfola, D., Anderson, A., Baier, H., et al. (2020). geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE, 15(4), e0231866.
sources.geo:creator: geoBoundaries, William & Mary geoLab

sources.title: Mendez, C., Gonzales, E., Leoni, P., Andersen, L., & Peralta, H. (2026). DS4Bolivia: A Data Science Repository to Study GeoSpatial Development in Bolivia [Data set]. GitHub.
sources.geo:creator: Carlos Mendez, Erick Gonzales, Pedro Leoni, Lykke Andersen and Hernán Peralta

geo:citation: GeoDevelopment Observatory of Bolivia (2026). Satellite embeddings 2017, population-weighted (339 municipalities). https://github.com/quarcs-lab/geo4bolivia/blob/main/docs/datasets/embpw.md
geo:notes: The dimensions are not interpretable one by one and should not be aggregated; their aggregation rule is `none`.
Computed by DS4Bolivia in Google Earth Engine on its own municipal polygons (`asdf_id`), which differ slightly from the GADM boundaries used for geo IDs.

Each pixel is weighted by WorldPop 100 m population, spread evenly over its 10 m pixels (code/aggregate-satellite-embedings-to-adm-pop-weighted1.js in DS4Bolivia), so the embeddings describe where people live. For the area-weighted version, see the `emb` dataset.

resources.name: embpw-municipality
resources.geo:source_geometry: DS4Bolivia polygons (bolivia339geoqueryFull, keyed by asdf_id), matched one-to-one to the GADM 4.1 municipalities by area overlap

fields.name: geo_id
fields.title: Municipality ID
fields.description: Municipality geo ID (BO-DD-PP-MM) in the GADM 4.1 hierarchy of the 339-unit municipality map. It nests by prefix into the department (BO-DD) and province (BO-DD-PP) IDs; department and province numbers follow GADM order and differ from INE codes.

fields.name: year
fields.title: Year
fields.description: Year of the satellite embeddings and population weights (2017).

fields.name: asdf_id
fields.title: DS4Bolivia polygon ID
fields.description: ID (AidData asdf_id) of the geoBoundaries v4 ADM3 polygon on which DS4Bolivia computed the data, matched one-to-one to the GADM municipality by area overlap.
fields.geo:source: DS4Bolivia

fields.name: A00
fields.title: Embedding A00 (population-weighted)
fields.description: Dimension 0 of the 64-dimensional Google Satellite Embedding V1 (AlphaEarth Foundations), annual 10 m embeddings for 2017, averaged over the municipality with each 10 m pixel weighted by its population (WorldPop 100 m, 2017, resampled to 10 m): Σ(embedding × population) / Σ population. It describes the places where people live. An abstract feature without a physical unit.

fields.description: Dimension 52 of the 64-dimensional Google Satellite Embedding V1 (AlphaEarth Foundations), annual 10 m embeddings for 2017, averaged over the municipality with each 10 m pixel weighted by its population (WorldPop 100 m, 2017, resampled to 10 m): Σ(embedding × population) / Σ population. It describes the places where people live. An abstract feature without a physical unit.
fields.geo:source: Google Satellite Embedding V1 via DS4Bolivia
